issue: FORM_BUILDERS = {form_with, form_for, form_tag} omits the other two form constructs scan() reports: raw-form (`<form`) and tag-builder-field (`tag.form`). Repro: a ```erb block with `<%# simple-form-only: primitive <form -- x %>` then `<form action="/x"></form>` -> findings == []; same with `primitive tag.form -- x` + `<%= tag.form(...) %>` -> []. CHANGELOG ('never excuses a form builder') and #1460 ('any construct the form-* rules report'; a primitive builds one control, never a form) are contradicted. Fix: add '<form' and 'tag.form' to FORM_BUILDERS (or derive: refuse any marker whose construct scan() reports under form-with/form-tag/raw-form or tag.form), plus a fixture and a mutation each.

Closing part `\2[`~]*` lets a mixed line close a block: ```erb ... then a line ```~~~ ends the block, so a later `<form>` before the real ``` is unread (repro -> []). CommonMark: a closing fence is the fence character only. Fix: `\2(?:(?<=`)`*|(?<=~)~*)[ \t]*$` or a backreference to the char, with a fixture + mutation.

A valid marker that excuses no instance is silent (repro: marker for check_box_tag in a block with none -> []). Under one-instance accounting a spare marker is a pre-paid excuse for the next check_box_tag added - the exact #1460 scenario. check_simple_form_only already reports an exemption that matches nothing. Fix: report leftover named[k] > 0 as primitive-marker-unused.

'Is simple_form API' and 'satisfies the wrapper mandate' are different tests; maintainer should record which governs, and update the docstring rationale accordingly. Split out: #1458 now waits on the maintainer's decision (simple_form API vs the wrapper rule).

The docstring list of 'simple_form's own' methods (f.input ... f.simple_fields_for) does not name collection_check_boxes/collection_radio_buttons, now allowed. Fix: add them to that sentence. Split out with #1458.
